sentences.arabic: Q3eSE_LS0_U05_06_Listening2_ActivitiesA_B_D
sentences.audio: assets/audio/Q3eSE_LS0_U05_06_Listening2_ActivitiesA_B_D.mp3

sentences.english: Good evening.
sentences.arabic: مساء الخير.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/Good evening.mp3

sentences.english: I’m Dr. Ross Chan.
sentences.arabic: أنا الدكتور ر.أوس تشان
sentences.audio: assets/audio/I’m Dr. Ross Chan.mp3

sentences.english: and I’m talking today about housing.
sentences.arabic: وأنا أتحدث اليوم عن السكن.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/and I’m talking today about housing.mp3

sentences.english: We have a beautiful new university in Jackson.
sentences.arabic: لدينا جامعة جديدة وجميلة في جاكسون.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/We have a beautiful new university in Jackson.mp3

sentences.english: but the campus is small
sentences.arabic: لكن الحرم الجامعي صغير
sentences.audio: assets/audio/but the campus is small.mp3

sentences.english: and we don’t have enough dormitories for all of our students.
sentences.arabic: ولا لدينا ما يكفي من السكن الجامعي لجميع طلابنا.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/and we don’t have enough dormitories for all of our students.mp3

sentences.english: We have a housing shortage.
sentences.arabic: لدينا نقص في المساكن.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/We have a housing shortage.mp3

sentences.english: There is some housing in town.
sentences.arabic: هناك بعض المساكن في المدينة.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/There is some housing in town.mp3

sentences.english: but many apartments aren’t affordable for students.
sentences.arabic: لكن العديد من الشقق غير ميسورة للطلاب.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/but many apartments aren’t affordable for students.mp3

sentences.english: Some students live in small
sentences.arabic: بعض الطلاب يعيشون في أماكن صغيرة
sentences.audio: assets/audio/Some students live in small.mp3

sentences.english: inexpensive apartments.
sentences.arabic: شقق رخيصة
sentences.audio: assets/audio/inexpensive apartments.mp3

sentences.english: Some students live in small, inexpensive apartments downtown.
sentences.arabic: بعض الطلاب يعيشون في شقق صغيرة ورخيصة في وسط المدينة.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/Some students live in small, inexpensive apartments downtown.mp3

sentences.english: These apartments are near public transportation
sentences.arabic: هذه الشقق قريبة من وسائل النقل العام.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/These apartments are near public transportation.mp3

sentences.english: restaurants, and stores
sentences.arabic: المطاعم والمتاجر
sentences.audio: assets/audio/restaurants, and stores.mp3

sentences.english: There is also a lot of entertainment downtown on Market Street
sentences.arabic: هناك أيضًا الكثير من الترفيه في وسط المدينة في شارع ماركت.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/There is also a lot of entertainment downtown on Market Street.mp3

sentences.english: But the downtown area is dangerous at night.
sentences.arabic: لكن منطقة وسط المدينة خطيرة بالليل.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/But the downtown area is dangerous at night.mp3

sentences.english: and the apartments are in old buildings.
sentences.arabic: لكن منطقة وسط المدينة خطيرة بالليل.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/and the apartments are in old buildings.mp3

sentences.english: The buildings are in bad condition.
sentences.arabic: لكن منطقة وسط المدينة خطيرة بالليل.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/The buildings are in bad condition.mp3

sentences.english: And even these apartments are starting to become expensive.
sentences.arabic: وحتى هذه الشقق بدأت تصبح غالية.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/And even these apartments are starting to become expensive.mp3

sentences.english: So what is another choice for students?
sentences.arabic: إذاً ما هو خيار آخر للطلاب؟
sentences.audio: assets/audio/So what is another choice for students.mp3

sentences.english: Well, some other students share houses near campus with friends.
sentences.arabic: Well, some other students share houses near campus with friends?
sentences.audio: assets/audio/Well, some other students share houses near campus with friends.mp3

sentences.english: These houses are in safe neighborhoods.
sentences.arabic: هذه المنازل في أحياء آمنة.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/These houses are in safe neighborhoods.mp3

sentences.english: but they are expensive.
sentences.arabic: لكنها غالية.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/but they are expensive.mp3

sentences.english: and they are very crowded and noisy.
sentences.arabic: وهي مزدحمة وصاخبة جدًا.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/and they are very crowded and noisy.mp3

sentences.english: Students can’t study at home.
sentences.arabic: الطلاب ما يقدروش يذاكروا في البيت.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/Students can’t study at home.mp3

sentences.english: and sometimes they can’t get enough sleep.
sentences.arabic: وأحيانًا لا يستطيعون الحصول على قسط كافٍ من النوم.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/and sometimes they can’t get enough sleep.mp3

sentences.english: Other students live at home with their families.
sentences.arabic: طلاب آخرون يعيشون في المنزل مع عائلاتهم
sentences.audio: assets/audio/Other students live at home with their families.mp3

sentences.english: They live in a safe space
sentences.arabic: هم يعيشون في مكان آمن
sentences.audio: assets/audio/They live in a safe space.mp3

sentences.english: and they don’t pay rent
sentences.arabic: وهم لا يدفعون الإيجار
sentences.audio: assets/audio/and they don’t pay rent.mp3

sentences.english: But this choice is not possible for all students.
sentences.arabic: لكن هذا الخيار ليس ممكنًا لجميع الطلاب.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/But this choice is not possible for all students.mp3

sentences.english: Many of them move here from different cities
sentences.arabic: الكثير منهم ينتقلون إلى هنا من مدن مختلفة.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/Many of them move here from different cities.mp3

sentences.english: and their families live far away.
sentences.arabic: وعائلاتهم تعيش بعيدا.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/and their families live far away.mp3

sentences.english: We at the university are all very worried about this problem.
sentences.arabic: نحن في الجامعة جميعنا قلقون جدًا بشأن هذه المشكلة.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/We at the university are all very worried about this problem.mp3

sentences.english: We have a wonderful new university.
sentences.arabic: لدينا جامعة جديدة رائعة.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/We have a wonderful new university.mp3
